title: Extraordinary Life Stories (Bloomberg TV) — Eric on delegating thought to AI: 'What a scandal — an industrial-scale scandal'
summary: John Reynolds is an entrepreneur and investor whose show Extraordinary Life Stories airs on Bloomberg TV and draws on what guests got wrong before it worked. Eric talked about his own failures, named trust as the asset a leader most needs, and turned to what AI is doing to the way people learn.
blockquote: I know a lot of college professors who say that AI is robbing their students of the ability to learn because they don't read. They just ask for the summary. They delegate their thinking to the AI. Everyone's so excited about the possibility of replacing human creativity with AI. What a scandal — an industrial-scale scandal. Instead, we should use AI to augment creativity. So next time you're tempted to ask AI to make an artifact for you — write me a novel, write me a poem, write me a piece of software — just one subtle change: ask the AI to teach you how to do the task instead.
blockquote_source: Eric Ries on Extraordinary Life Stories with John Reynolds
